official_FS90MG: datasheets/FS90MG.pdf p.5, edition A/0, 2021-04-30, all ±0.1 mm

servos.head_pan: FS90MG in yaw_collar, software ±42°, hard stop ±47°
servos.arm_L: FS90MG direct drive, software −45…+30°, upper clasp blade
servos.arm_R: FS90MG direct drive, software −45…+30°, lower clasp blade

arm_angle_convention: 0 = arm straight forward (-y), + = up; rotation about the x axis through y=13, z=60

clasp.mechanism: overlapping scissor-blade forearms on the two shoulder servos; no added parts
clasp.grip_force_basis: datasheet stall 2.2 kg·cm at 6 V; not measured
clasp.compliance: 2 mm fur sleeve over each blade (≈4 mm of compressible pile in the clasp). Squeeze is set by commanding the blades past contact; the servo's position loop then pushes up to stall. No spring or breakaway part.

arm_hard_stop: first head contact at about +42° (outside the +30° clamp); blade-to-blade contact below 7.5° interlock — arm limits are software only
